summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests (the instructions barred execution), so everything is unverified and checked only by reading. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, Tabs, and the internal TabsRenderable; UnderlineBar now yields one Text and accepts clickable_ranges before width, with click spans applied last and none on the zero-width early path; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so attributes and click metadata survive; tests added to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py (existing assertions unchanged) and a new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py; docs/reference/tabs.md added. The layout resolver needed no change because Edge already has size, min_size (default 1), and fraction (default 1). Judgment calls: Tabs sets can_focus = True so it receives keys; letter search only runs for single-character keys; a zero-width label gets no resolver edge; no filler is added when fixed padding leaves cells unused; the sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Known issue: with duplicate names, the bar position uses the full-list find_tab_by_name index while the bar is laid out over displayed (deduplicated) tabs, so the underline can sit under the wrong tab. I followed the spec literally; fixing it would contradict the spec's wording, so it needs the user's decision. Nothing was committed.
